newsitem.title: CANADA: ID Biomed says MRSA test accurate in study.
newsitem.headline: ID Biomed says MRSA test accurate in study.

text.p: ID Biomedical Corp said Thursday that a preliminary in-house blinded study of its rapid culture confirmation test for methicillin-resistant staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) showed 100 percent accuracy.

The company said the test on clinical isolates of MRSA and regular staphylococcus in non-radioactive format was able to detect the drug-resistant samples with 100 percent accuracy. Fort-eight isolates were tested by three technicians resulting in a total of 144 accurate results and no errors.

Calling the results positive, the company said they were important because it was the first time it had demonstrated its cycling probe technology system working with clinical samples in a commercial format.

The company will complete more development work over the next three months in preparation for independent clinical trials. If successful, those trials would be followed by applications for marketing approval in the United States and Canada.
